header.title: Toast
header.description: Short notifications shown above the interface to confirm an action or report a problem. Fire them with `toast()` from anywhere and render them in a `Toaster`, or use `Toast` directly inside the page. `Snackbar` is an alias of `Toast`.

info.title: New version available
info.description: Reload the page to get the latest improvements.

warning.title: Storage almost full
warning.description: You have used 90% of the available storage.

error.title: Could not send
error.description: Check your connection and try again.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Adjust the props to preview the toast and its code. The button fires it on the page's global `Toaster`. `closeAriaLabel` is passed on every call because the default is `Dismiss`.

system.title: Notification system
system.description: `toast()` and its shortcuts `toast.info`, `toast.success`, `toast.warning` and `toast.error` add a notification to the `Toaster` of its `scope`. Each call returns the id. `autoClose: 0` keeps it open with no bar and `Infinity` keeps it open with an indeterminate bar. `toast.dismiss()` without an id closes them all. The examples use a local `Toaster` (`ToastHost`) so they don't mix with the global one.

persistent.title: Session about to expire
persistent.description: Save your work: the session ends in 5 minutes.

infinite.title: Syncing files
infinite.description: Stays visible until you close it.

base.title: Basic usage
base.description: `Toast` can also be used on its own, inside the page. It shows `title`, the `children` content and the close button. Standalone, it doesn't close on a timer: `autoClose` is `0`.

status.title: Status
status.description: `status` sets the color and icon: `info` (default), `success`, `warning` or `error`. `warning` and `error` are announced with `role="alert"`; the others with `role="status"`.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: `variant` changes the style: `soft` (tinted background, default), `solid` (filled background) or `outline` (neutral background with a colored border).

sizes.title: Sizes and radius
sizes.description: `size` adjusts padding and text: `sm`, `md` (default) or `lg`. `radius` rounds the corners with `sm`, `md` (default) or `lg`.

description.title: Text only
description.description: Without `title`, the content is shown as the main text. `isClosable={false}` removes the close button.

action.title: With action
action.description: `action` adds a button on the side, for example to retry or undo. On `solid`, the transparent button needs `text-current` to take the toast color.

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: `icon` replaces the status icon and `hideIcon` hides it.

texts.title: Reminder
texts.description: The team meeting starts in 10 minutes.

custom.title: Custom content
custom.description: `custom` replaces the whole content (icon, texts and action) with your own. The close button stays.

autoClose.title: Auto close
autoClose.description: `autoClose` closes the toast after that many milliseconds and shows a progress bar. `Infinity` keeps it open with an indeterminate bar and `showProgress={false}` hides the bar. With `pauseOnHover` (default) the timer pauses on hover or focus.

texts.infiniteText: Stays visible until you close it.

controlled.title: Controlled
controlled.description: With `open` and `onOpenChange` you drive visibility from your state. `onClose` is called when it closes.

placement.title: Placement
placement.description: The `Toaster` `placement` puts notifications in a corner or in the center, top or bottom. Default: `bottom-end`.

stack.title: On-screen limit
stack.description: The `Toaster` `max` limits how many are visible at once (default `5`). When exceeded, the oldest is dropped.

update.title: Update
update.description: With a fixed `id`, `toast.update(id, options)` changes an open toast, for example when an upload finishes. If it was already closed, it does nothing. Firing another one with the same `id` replaces the previous one.

uploading.title: Uploading report
uploading.description: This may take a few seconds.

done.title: Report uploaded
done.description: It's now available to the team.

snackbar.title: Snackbar alias
snackbar.description: `Snackbar` is the same component as `Toast`, with the same props.

texts.title: Conversation archived
texts.description: You can find it in the archive folder.

texts.title: Order confirmed
texts.description: We'll let you know when it ships.

header.title: Toast API
header.description: API reference for the React Toast: the toast function, its options, the Toaster, props, CSS classes, variables, tokens and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demos page.

import.title: Import
import.description: You can import it from the main entry or from its subpath. `Snackbar` is an alias of `Toast` and `ToastProvider` renders its `children` along with a `Toaster`.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Toast accepts <div> attributes except title, and they go to the root along with ref, id and className. classNames adds classes to each part. The toast() options are a subset of the Toast props: no HTML attributes, className, role or events. Toaster renders the region in a portal on container.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.role: info and success use role="status"; warning and error use role="alert", announced immediately. You can change it with role.
a11y.viewport: The Toaster is a region with role="region", aria-live="polite" and the viewportLabel name.
a11y.labels: Default names are in English: "Notifications" for the region and "Dismiss" for the close button. Pass viewportLabel to the Toaster and closeAriaLabel on each toast when using another language.
a11y.close: The close button is a real <button> and works with the keyboard.
a11y.pause: With pauseOnHover, the timer pauses on hover or focus, giving time to read it or use the action.
a11y.timing: For important messages or those with actions, use autoClose: 0 or Infinity so they don't disappear on their own.
a11y.action: The action is your own button: give it clear text. If it's critical, offer another way to do it outside the toast.
a11y.motion: With prefers-reduced-motion the enter and exit animations are removed.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Classes you can use to override styles.

rules.root: Toast root. Defines the variables. Receives `className` and `classNames.root`.
rules.withProgress: Applied when the progress bar is shown.
rules.row: Row with icon, texts, action and close button.
rules.title: Title. Receives `classNames.title`.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Toast's own variables. Status and variant ones are overridden by a class with the same specificity, so use `.gem-toast.your-class` plus a `[data-theme="dark"]` variant.

items.--gem-toast-bg: Background. Set by status and variant.
items.--gem-toast-accent: Accent color: progress bar and details.
items.--gem-toast-gap: Space between icon, texts and action.
items.--gem-toast-offset: Region distance to the edge. Set by the `Toaster` `offset`.
items.--gem-toast-from-y: Vertical offset of the enter animation.

items.--gem-space-2: Space between toasts in the region.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

props.title: Props
props.description: The API is split into the `toast` function, its options, the `Toaster` and the `Toast` component.

api.title: toast function
api.description: Import it and call it from anywhere. Needs a mounted `Toaster` with the same `scope`.

items.message: Shows a toast with that title and returns its id.
items.options: Same, but the title and the other options go in an object.
items.status: Shortcuts that set `status`. They take the same arguments.
items.update: Changes the options of an open toast. If it was already closed, it does nothing.
items.dismiss: Closes the toast with that id. Without an id, closes all of them, in every scope.
items.useToast: Hook that returns `toasts` (the open ones) and the `toast`, `update` and `dismiss` functions.

items.id: Toast id. If one with that id already exists, it's replaced.
items.autoClose: Milliseconds until it closes. If omitted, uses the `Toaster` value. `0` or `Infinity` keep it open.

toaster.title: Toaster
toaster.description: Region where toasts appear. Mount one per `scope`. Its values are the defaults of each toast.

items.autoClose: Default time until closing, in milliseconds.
items.showProgress: Shows the progress bar by default.
items.max: Maximum visible count. When exceeded, the oldest is dropped.
items.offset: Distance to the edge. A number is taken as pixels.
items.isClosable: Shows the close button by default.
items.pauseOnHover: Pauses the timer on hover or focus, by default.
items.scope: Only shows toasts of this scope.
items.classNames: Classes for `viewport` and for each toast.

toast.title: Toast
toast.description: Visual component. Also usable on its own, inside the page.

items.title: Bold title.
items.children: Content. Without `title`, it's shown as the main text.
items.status: Status: sets the color, icon and `role`.
items.action: Content on the side, for example a button.
items.custom: Replaces icon, texts and action with your own content.
items.closeAriaLabel: Accessible name of the close button.
items.autoClose: Milliseconds until it closes. Standalone, the default is `0` (never closes).
items.showProgress: Shows the progress bar when there is `autoClose`. With `Infinity`, the bar is indeterminate.
items.pauseOnHover: Pauses the timer on hover or focus.
items.role: Root role. By default it depends on `status`.
items.onClose: Called when it closes, by the button or on timer.
